info.title: Learn the eight
info.text: Knowing 128, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2 and 1 by heart is most of the work. Say them out loud until they're automatic.

info.title: Nibbles
info.text: Because one hex digit is exactly four bits, binary to hex never needs any arithmetic: just split into nibbles and look each one up.

info.title: Check your answer
info.text: After converting to binary, add the place values back up. If you don't get the original number, you've slipped somewhere.

info.title: Why bother?
info.text: Conversion questions appear in nearly every exam paper, and they're marks you can guarantee with practice.
